name: Ahead of It · Church
intro: You will pick church obligations from the ready-made library, add one through Quick setup that is overdue on purpose, then tick off its step and mark it done — with a reload and Airplane Mode along the way.

steps.do: On the welcome card at the bottom, tap “skip the tour” (small words, bottom-right).
steps.see: The card changes to “How do you want to start?” with two big buttons.

steps.do: Tap “✨ Start fresh with my own”. (If a small box asks “Start fresh? The examples will be cleared.”, tap “OK”.)
steps.see: The card closes (on a new phone the box may not come — that is fine). The page says “Nothing overdue. That is the whole point.” and the small badge near the top says “empty”.
steps.tip: This test does not use the orange ＋ or an item's name — please leave them alone for now.

steps.do: Near the top, tap “Pick from the library →”.
steps.see: The Library opens: ready-made church obligations grouped by kind (Safety & inspections, Building, Vehicles, Insurance & legal, Money & filings, Seasonal), each showing how often it comes round.
A short note says “Added — tap it to fix the date”, and the van button fades and says “added”.

steps.do: Under Insurance & legal, tap “Property & liability insurance renewal”.
steps.see: “Added — tap it to fix the date” again, and that button now says “added” too.
A short note says “Already on your list” — it is not added twice.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: The app opens on its main page. Both items are listed, each saying in how many days it is due, and the badge at the top says “all clear”.

steps.do: Tap the gold “⚡ Quick setup — tick what’s yours” button near the bottom.
steps.see: “⚡ Quick setup” opens: the whole library on one screen, a tick box and a date beside each. The van and the insurance are marked ✓ (already added).

steps.do: Without ticking anything new, scroll to the very bottom and tap “Save my list — however many that is”.
steps.see: A small box says “Tick at least one box — or Close if nothing applies today.” Tap “OK”.

steps.do: Scroll up to Safety & inspections and tick “Boiler / furnace inspection”. Then tap its date and change it to any day last month (overdue on purpose). Tap Done.
steps.see: The boiler box is ticked and its date shows a day last month.

steps.do: Scroll to the bottom and tap “Save my list — however many that is”.
steps.see: A small box says “1 item on your list, with dates. That’s a real start. 🌿” — tap “OK”. The page reloads: under “OVERDUE” the number is 1, “Boiler / furnace inspection” says “… days overdue” with a red “costs money” label, and the badge says “1 overdue · 1 cost money”.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then on the boiler inspection tap “step ✓”.
steps.see: A brown bar at the top says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” A short note says “Step done ✓” and the boiler's step line now says “Do it now”.

steps.do: On the boiler inspection, tap “done ✓”. Then turn Airplane Mode off.
steps.see: A short note starts “Done ✓ — next one …” with a future date. “OVERDUE” now says “Nothing overdue. That is the whole point.”, the badge says “all clear”, and the brown bar goes away.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it once more.
steps.see: All three items are still listed — the van registration, the insurance renewal and the boiler inspection (now with a future date) — and the badge says “all clear”. That's the end — thank you!
